checks.exercise: Bodyweight squat: continuous descent, short bottom transition, controlled return.
checks.equipment: No external load. Register bodyweight only; barbell and machine variants excluded.
checks.setup: Final front/side and both encoded 32-frame sheets inspected. Soft standing knee bend after root-height correction.
checks.hands: Both arms forward, softly bent elbows; hands remain within frame.
checks.feet: Shoulder-width fixed ankles, slightly outward toes, no visible foot sliding in side sheet; 481-sample drift below 1e-6.
checks.movement: Hips travel backward/down toward parallel and return. Final light/dark sheets show clear full cycle without visible garment tearing. Not exhaustive continuous collision validation.

checks.exercise: Bodyweight pulse squat; two bottom-range pulses between entry and exit.
checks.equipment: Bodyweight only; no weight or support omitted.
checks.setup: Final side sheet and both encoded 32-frame sheets inspected; stance matches ordinary squat.
checks.hands: Arms forward with softly bent elbows, no frame clipping.
checks.feet: Both ankles fixed across 481 samples; flat-foot orientation constant.
checks.movement: Middle four seconds stay low with two visible pulses; hip excursion .954 model units. Full rise occurs only on exit. No visible shorts openings in reviewed frames; not exhaustive collision validation.

checks.exercise: Hip-width chair pose with overhead arms, moderate seated bend and static hold.
checks.equipment: Bodyweight yoga variant, no actual chair required.
checks.setup: Final side sheet and both encoded 32-frame sheets inspected; heels and fingertips remain in frame.
checks.hands: Arms lift overhead without hand-head overlap, then lower on exit.
checks.feet: Hip-width fixed ankles, constant foot orientation; no hopping or visible sliding.
checks.movement: Entry two seconds, steady hold four seconds, exit two seconds; measured joint drift zero during hold. Illustrated hold does not prescribe a training duration.
